title: Conserved IQ motifs, divergent apo-calmodulin recognition in UBE3B and UBE3C.
authors: Schaffter, Emily G; Lu, Xiaohuan; Tinklenberg, Anna E; Hill, Megan G; Levin, Rafael H; Tabima, Javier F; Huo, Shuanghong; Spratt, Donald E
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文结合NMR、ITC和计算建模（结构模型与MD模拟）研究UBE3B与UBE3C中保守IQ基序对apo-CaM的不同识别模式，虽以蛋白-蛋白结合机制为核心，但计算模拟仅作为辅助解释，方法创新性有限。
abstract: Calmodulin (CaM) regulates diverse signaling proteins through recognition of short linear motifs, including isoleucine-glutamine (IQ) motifs that commonly bind Ca(2+)-free CaM (apo-CaM). The homologous to E6AP carboxyl terminus (HECT) E3 ubiquitin ligases ubiquitin protein ligase E3B (UBE3B) and ubiquitin protein ligase E3C (UBE3C) are closely related enzymes that both contain N-terminal IQ motifs, yet whether these motifs encode conserved modes of apo-CaM recognition has remained unclear. Here, we combined isothermal titration calorimetry, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, and computational modeling to compare apo-CaM binding by the UBE3B and UBE3C IQ motifs. The UBE3B IQ motif bound apo-CaM with high affinity and preferentially engaged the CaM C-lobe, whereas the UBE3C IQ motif interacted more weakly under the same conditions. NMR titrations revealed distinct molecular recognition modes-UBE3B IQ binding occurred in slow exchange and produced a localized C-lobe interaction surface, while UBE3C IQ binding occurred in fast exchange and generated smaller, more distributed chemical shift perturbations. Structural models and molecular dynamics simulations provide a framework for interpreting these divergent apo-CaM engagement modes despite conservation of canonical IQ motif features. Phylogenetic analysis further suggests that the UBE3B and UBE3C IQ motifs have followed divergent evolutionary trajectories within the broader IQ motif family. Together, these findings show that conserved IQ motifs in related HECT ligases can encode different apo-CaM binding modes, providing a molecular basis for divergent CaM-mediated regulation of UBE3B and UBE3C.
abstract_zh: 钙调蛋白（CaM）通过识别短线性基序来调控多种信号蛋白，其中包括通常结合无钙离子CaM（apo-CaM）的异亮氨酸-谷氨酰胺（IQ）基序。与E6AP羧基末端同源的（HECT）E3泛素连接酶——泛素蛋白连接酶E3B（UBE3B）和泛素蛋白连接酶E3C（UBE3C）是密切相关的酶，两者均含有N端IQ基序，然而这些基序是否编码保守的apo-CaM识别模式仍不清楚。在此，我们结合等温滴定量热法、核磁共振（NMR）波谱法和计算建模，比较了UBE3B和UBE3C IQ基序对apo-CaM的结合。UBE3B IQ基序以高亲和力结合apo-CaM，并优先与CaM的C-叶相互作用，而UBE3C IQ基序在相同条件下相互作用较弱。NMR滴定揭示了不同的分子识别模式——UBE3B IQ结合发生在慢交换中，并产生局部化的C-叶相互作用表面，而UBE3C IQ结合发生在快交换中，并产生较小、更分散的化学位移扰动。结构模型和分子动力学模拟为解释这些不同的apo-CaM结合模式提供了框架，尽管保留了典型的IQ基序特征。系统发育分析进一步表明，UBE3B和UBE3C IQ基序在更广泛的IQ基序家族中遵循了不同的进化轨迹。综合这些发现表明，相关HECT连接酶中保守的IQ基序可以编码不同的apo-CaM结合模式，为CaM介导的UBE3B和UBE3C差异性调控提供了分子基础。
